brief.title: Amazon Product Catalog Performance & Customer Sentiment Analysis
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive analysis of 1,400+ Amazon products examining pricing strategies, discount effectiveness, customer ratings, and category-level performance to identify optimization opportunities.
brief.goal: Equip product and category managers with data-driven insights on which product categories, price ranges, and discount strategies yield the highest customer satisfaction, enabling informed decisions on assortment curation, pricing adjustments, and promotional planning.

required_sections.title: Executive Overview
required_sections.objective: Summarize the dataset scope and present headline metrics including total products analyzed, average rating, median discount percentage, and top-performing categories.

required_sections.title: Category Performance Breakdown
required_sections.objective: Analyze product distribution, average ratings, and average discount percentages across top-level and sub-level categories. Identify the best- and worst-performing categories by customer rating and engagement (rating_count).

required_sections.title: Pricing & Discount Strategy Analysis
required_sections.objective: Examine the relationship between actual price, discounted price, discount percentage, and customer ratings. Determine whether deeper discounts correlate with higher ratings or higher review volumes.

required_sections.title: Customer Engagement & Rating Distribution
required_sections.objective: Profile the distribution of ratings and rating counts across products. Identify products with exceptionally high engagement and analyze what characteristics they share.

required_sections.title: Review Sentiment Snapshot
required_sections.objective: Provide a high-level qualitative overview of review titles and content, highlighting common positive and negative themes mentioned by customers.

required_sections.title: Strategic Recommendations
required_sections.objective: Synthesize findings into 3-5 actionable recommendations for category management, pricing optimization, and customer experience improvement.

kpis.name: Average Product Rating
kpis.description: Mean rating across all products in the dataset (scale of 1-5).

kpis.name: Average Discount Percentage
kpis.description: Mean discount percentage offered across all products, indicating overall promotional intensity.

kpis.name: Median Rating Count
kpis.description: Median number of customer ratings per product, reflecting typical customer engagement levels.

kpis.name: High-Rating Product Share
kpis.description: Percentage of products with a rating of 4.0 or above, indicating catalog quality.

kpis.name: Price-to-Discount Efficiency
kpis.description: Correlation between discount percentage and customer rating, measuring whether discounts translate into higher satisfaction.
